title: Integrate Hero Section into Landing Page
description: Replace the existing hero or placeholder content in app/page.tsx with the new Hero component.
details: Import the new Hero component at the top of app/page.tsx and render it as the first section. Remove any outdated or placeholder hero content to avoid duplication. Ensure the rest of the landing page sections follow the new hero. Confirm that the CTA button(s) correctly route to /sign-up (and /sign-in if present) using Next.js Link or equivalent.
test_strategy: Manually verify that the hero section appears at the top of the landing page, that CTA buttons navigate correctly, and that there is no duplicate or obsolete content. Check for SSR/SSG compatibility.

title: Ensure Responsive Design and Visual Consistency
description: Test and refine the Hero section for responsiveness and visual consistency across all major breakpoints and browsers.
details: Use browser dev tools and responsive design testing to verify the Hero section looks and functions correctly on mobile, tablet, and desktop. Adjust Tailwind CSS classes as needed for spacing, typography, and layout. Ensure the design matches the overall shadcn/ui theme and application aesthetic.
test_strategy: Perform cross-browser and cross-device manual testing. Use visual regression tools if available. Validate color contrast and accessibility with tools like Axe or Lighthouse.

title: Validate Accessibility and SEO Metadata
description: Ensure the Hero section meets accessibility standards and includes appropriate SEO metadata.
details: Check that semantic HTML is used (e.g., <section>, <h1>), ARIA attributes are present where necessary, and all interactive elements are keyboard accessible. Confirm that the landing page includes relevant metadata (title, description, Open Graph tags) for the hero section content, updating if needed.
test_strategy: Run accessibility audits (Axe, Lighthouse). Manually test keyboard navigation. Verify metadata in the page source and with social sharing previews.
